intro.title: 📋 Before you start
intro.body: Have your documents ready before you start: you will need to upload the required ones to move to the next page.
intro.doc_payslips: Your last 3 payslips, one per month (if you are paid every two weeks, 6: one per pay period) — if you are a pensioner, your pension letter (optional)
intro.doc_bancos: Your last 3 bank statements, one per month, as a PDF downloaded from online banking
intro.doc_carta: Employment letter (not needed if you are a pensioner)
intro.doc_opcionales: Optional: passport or driver's license, proof of address (Aqualectra, phone bill, Kranshi extract or residence permit)

step1.title: Identification
step1.hint: Upload a clear photo of your ID. We will extract your information automatically.
step1.tipo_empleado_hint: If you are a pensioner, payslips are optional — you can use a pension letter instead.
step1.frecuencia_salario: How often do you get paid? *
step1.frecuencia_hint: This determines how many payslips you must upload (3 if monthly, 6 if biweekly).

step2.title: Financial Documents
step2.hint: Upload your payslips and bank statements for the last 3 months (if you are paid every two weeks, one payslip per pay period).
step2.payslips: 📄 Payslips (3, one per month; 6 if paid every two weeks) *
step2.payslips_explain: Upload one payslip per month (or per pay period, if you are paid every two weeks) — we use them to confirm your income.
step2.pension_explain: Upload the most recent pension letter.
step2.bancos_explain: Upload one statement per month — PDF only, downloaded from your internet banking.
step2.banco_pdf_only: PDF only — download from your bank's internet banking.
step2.comprobante_domicilio: 📄 Aqualectra, phone bill, Kranshi extract or residence permit (optional)
step2.comprobante_hint: Proof of address. Any of these works — what we need is the address.
step2.choose_tipo_first: First choose employment type and (if applicable) salary frequency in Step 2.

step3.title: Personal Information
step3.inhouden: Does your employer accept salary deduction (inhouden)?
step3.inhouden_si: Yes, I asked and they accept it
step3.inhouden_no: No, they do not accept it
step3.inhouden_hint: With inhouden you have a better chance of approval, because the instalment comes straight out of your salary.
step3.inhouden_atestado: I confirm that I asked my employer and that they accept it. I understand that declaring this without checking can cost me the application.
step3.conyuge_hint: Your spouse must sign with you at the appointment, with valid photo ID. We use these same details as Reference 1.
step3.conyuge_sedula_hint: Optional. If you do not have it to hand, we complete it at the office.
step3.email_verify_hint: We sent a 6-digit code to your email. Enter it below:
step3.email_verify_check_spam: ⚠️ If you don't see it in your inbox, check Junk / Spam / Promotions too.
step3.email_verify_cooldown: Wait a few seconds before requesting another code.
step3.email_verify_exhausted: Too many attempts. Request a new code.
step3.email_verify_no_active: No active code. Request a new one.
step3.phone_verify_hint: We sent a 6-digit code to your WhatsApp. Enter it below:
step3.phone_verify_cooldown: Wait a few seconds before requesting another code.
step3.phone_verify_error: We couldn't complete the action. Try again.
step3.phone_verify_wrong: Wrong code. You have {left} attempts left.
step3.phone_verify_exhausted: Too many attempts. Request a new code.
step3.phone_verify_no_active: No active code. Request a new one.

step4.title: Health Declaration
step4.hint: For the life insurance included in your loan (mandatory for terms of 24 months or more). All answers are confidential.
step4.medico: Who is your family doctor? (name or "none")
step4.q1: 1/6. Do you currently have any serious health problem?
step4.q2: 2/6. Have you had an operation in the last 5 years?
step4.q3: 3/6. Do you currently have an illness, ailment or disability?
step4.q4: 4/6. Are you currently taking prescription medication?
step4.q5: 5/6. Have you been diagnosed with HIV or AIDS?
step4.q7: 6/6. Is there anything else about your health that could affect the insurance?

step5.title: Contact and References
step5.beneficiario_hint: If you leave this empty, Reference 1 is used as beneficiary.

step6.title: Your Loan
step6.hint: The instalment includes principal, interest and life insurance. For loans of 24 months or more it also includes the savings plan, which is returned to you at the end.
step6.proposito: What will you use the loan for? *
step6.monto_hint: Between {min} and {max} XCG, in multiples of 500.
step6.proposito_detalle_ph: Additional detail (optional; required if you choose "Other reason")
step6.q_fuera_politica: This amount and term need an additional review; the instalment may change.
step6.q_error: We could not calculate the instalment right now. You can continue with your application.
step6.ahorro_explain: You pay into it every month together with your instalment, and it is paid back to you when the loan ends. You can remove it.
step6.ahorro_suma_si: If you add it: {monto} more per month.
step6.q_costo_fees: Cost of credit (interest, insurance and fees):

step7.title: Confirm Your Application
step7.hint: Review all the information below. When you click "Submit application", your application is registered.
step7.legal_health: By submitting this application I declare that I have answered the previous questions fully and truthfully, and I acknowledge that any incorrect or incomplete health declaration may lead to refusal or modification of the rights under the insurance contract.
step7.legal_aska: By submitting this application I also declare that I have no objection to the medical adviser of Aska Insurance requesting medical information from my doctor or specialist.
step7.legal_credit_check: By submitting this application I authorise CFL to check my credit history with third-party providers and to verify my information with my employer.
step7.legal_credit_registration: Curaçao Fast Loans N.V. participates in a credit registration system and may carry out credit checks as part of its acceptance and monitoring procedures for loans.
step7.terms: I confirm all information is correct and I accept CFL's Terms and Conditions and Privacy Policy.

done.title: Application submitted!
done.thanks: Thank you for your trust in Curaçao Fast Loans.
done.id_hint: Keep this number and mention it when you contact us.
done.next_1: A CFL officer reviews your application and your documents.
done.next_2: We will contact you by WhatsApp or phone within 3 to 5 days.
done.next_3: If your application is approved, we will send you the offer with the final instalment and give you an appointment to sign.
